notes: The real fix for the missing logo. Open in Mail builds the email under its own render mode, and the logo swap only recognised the copy and gmail modes - so the button you actually send from kept embedding the picture, which Apple Mail renders and Gmail throws away. Changing where the file was hosted never touched that path, which is why three attempts made no difference. It now asks what the mode ISN'T (the preview and the PDF keep the real logo) so a new mode can't slip through the same gap again.
